evals.prompt: I put a config file at ~/.config/tuicr/config.toml but it's not showing up in my dotfiles repo at ~/Projects/dotfiles. I have stowd running as a launchd service. Why isn't it syncing, and how do I get it into my dotfiles?
evals.expected_output: Explains the one-directional watch model (stowd watches the repo, not $HOME), notes --adopt doesn't pick up brand-new home files, and recommends 'stowd dotfiles track tuicr ~/.config/tuicr' (with --dry-run first) or repo-first layout. Demonstrate dry-run.

evals.prompt: I want to pull ~/.config/opencode into my dotfiles repo as a stow package. Show me the exact stowd commands to do it, including a dry-run first, and explain what will happen at each step.
evals.expected_output: Produces accurate stowd CLI: 'stowd dotfiles track opencode ~/.config/opencode --dry-run' then the real command; describes move into repo, symlink creation, .stowd-state metadata, git commit.

evals.prompt: Is my stowd service running right now? Show me how to check its launchd status and read its logs, and tell me what common stowd errors look like in the logs.
evals.expected_output: Uses 'launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/com.orshemtov.stowd' and 'tail -f ~/Library/Logs/stowd.out.log ~/Library/Logs/stowd.err.log'; notes GNU Stow missing error and package-name validation failures.
